wall.e: There is a clock on the wall.

news.e: Strange to say, he didn't know the news.
news.c: 说来奇怪，他不知道这个消息。

personal.e: Please forgive my asking such a personal question.
personal.c: 请原谅我问了这样一个私人的问题。

test.e: I think you should take the test again.
test.c: 我的意见是，你该再次参加测试。

movie.e: He often goes with her to watch movies.
movie.c: 他常和她一起去看电影。

north.e: Spring in the north sends gales to sweep the roads.
north.c: 北方的春天送来狂风扫路。

eight.e: You should sleep for eight hours a day.
eight.c: 你应该每天睡八个小时觉。

computer.e: I don't know how to operate this computer.
computer.c: 我不知道怎么操作这台电脑.

private.e: If everything private is searched through by secret services, is that democracy?
private.c: 如果所有私人资讯都要经过秘密机构的搜查，那还能算是民主吗？

herself.e: She brought cakes that she made herself.
herself.c: 她带了些她自己做的蛋糕。

bit.e: I don't care a bit about the future.

technology.e: Modern technology has made our lives more comfortable.
technology.c: 现代科学技术让我们的生活更加舒适。

catch.e: Will he be able to catch the train?

wish.e: I hope I can get my wish fulfilled.
wish.c: 希望我的愿望能够实现。

step.c: 我们应该走出什么样的步伐。

baby.e: Their baby is able to walk already.
baby.c: 他们的小婴孩已经会走路了。

attention.e: You should pay more attention to his warnings.
attention.c: 你应该多注意他的警告。

achieve.e: How do you plan to achieve the goals you set?
achieve.c: 你们准备如何达到你们制定的目标？

film.e: I want to go to see a film.

choose.e: Teaching is a profession of my own choosing.
choose.c: 教书是我自己选择的职业。

deal.e: I don't make deals with people like you.
deal.c: 我不跟你这样的人做生意。

poor.e: Poor cat! She can't catch the nimble mouse.
poor.c: 可怜的猫！ 她无法抓住敏捷的老鼠。

nearly.e: We were nearly frozen to death.

wide.e: Life is not long, it is wide!

south.e: The north differs greatly from the south.
south.c: 南方和北方的差异很大。

twenty.e: Twenty dollars are one hundred and forty yuan.
twenty.c: 二十美金等于一百四十元。

listen.e: I don't know why you listen to her.
listen.c: 我不知道你为什么听她的话。

soon.e: The sky cleared up soon after the storm.
soon.c: 风暴之后不久,天空就晴朗起来了。

board.e: Yesterday's board meeting was a big success.
board.c: 昨天的董事会会议非常成功。

culture.e: It's good for our understanding of other cultures.
culture.c: 它有利于我们理解其他文化。

king.e: He acts as if he were a king.

chance.e: We were on the same train by chance.
chance.c: 我们偶然间乘了同一列列车。

secretary.e: The secretary stuffed the letter into an envelope.
secretary.c: 秘书把信塞到一个信封里。

energy.e: All his energies were devoted to the experiment.
energy.c: 他把全部精力放到实验中了。

fail.e: I tried many things but failed after all.
fail.c: 我尝试过很多东西，但最后都失败收场。

operation.e: I had an operation for glaucoma last year.
operation.c: 我去年动了青光眼手术。

summer.e: I like winter better than summer.

share.e: More and more married couples share household chores.
share.c: 夫妻分担家务的情况愈来愈普遍。

foreign.e: Have you ever been to a foreign country?

agreement.e: There needs to be agreement between European countries.
agreement.c: 欧洲各国之间需要达成协议。

plant.e: Many workers were laid off at that plant.
plant.c: 那个工厂开除了很多工人。

simple.e: The smallest child knows such a simple thing.
simple.c: 这么简单的东西三岁小孩也会。

choice.e: You have the choice of soup or salad.
choice.c: 你有两种选择，汤，或沙拉。

thousand.e: Thousands of people wanted to know the answer.
thousand.c: 成千上万的人想要知道答案。

husband.e: She was in despair when her husband died.
husband.c: 丈夫去世时她十分绝望。

floor.e: Her footsteps fell ponderously on the wooden floor.
floor.c: 她的脚步沉重地落在木地板上。

future.e: I don't care a bit about the future.

used.e: The people here are used to the cold.

colour.e: I think your new hair color looks good.
colour.c: 我觉得你新的头发颜色好看。

population.e: How large is the population of New York City?

rise.e: Anti-Chinese sentiment is on the rise in Myanmar.
rise.c: 缅甸反华情绪正在增长。

medical.e: She made a series of medical discoveries.
medical.c: 她提出了一连串的医学发现。

close.e: My house is close to a bus stop.
close.c: 我的房子靠近一个公车站牌。

shop.e: Is there a souvenir shop in the hotel?
shop.c: 旅馆里面有纪念品商店吗?

risk.e: We have no choice but to risk it.
risk.c: 我们别无选择只能冒着危险。

fire.e: The cause of the fire was unknown.

standard.e: We tried to come up to the standard.

purpose.e: What is the purpose of your visit?

anyone.e: He promised not to tell anyone about it.
anyone.c: 他承诺不会和任何人说这件事。

discuss.e: We discussed the problem for a long time.
discuss.c: 我们讨论那个问题讨论了很久。

myself.e: I managed to repair my car by myself.
myself.c: 我自己搞定，修好了我的车。

west.e: Individuality is very important in the West.

prove.e: The facts proved that our worries were unnecessary.
prove.c: 事实证明了我们的担心是多余的。

rest.e: What do you say to taking a rest?

fight.e: A group of young men were fighting.

throw.e: A good cook doesn't throw out yesterday's soup.
throw.c: 一个好的厨师不会丢掉昨天的汤。

present.e: The whole class is present once a week.
present.c: 全班同学每周出席一次。

top.e: Don't put anything on top of the box.
top.c: 不要放任何东西在箱子上面。

past.e: He seems to know all about her past.
past.c: 他对她的过去似乎了如指掌。

april.e: We were moving back to Algiers in April.
april.c: 我们四月要搬回阿尔及尔。

enjoy.e: Enjoy your life while you are able to.
enjoy.c: 能够的时候就好好享受人生吧。

fill.e: Please fill this bottle with water.

knowledge.e: Some consider language as a form of knowledge.
knowledge.c: 有些人认为语言是一种知识的形式。

drop.e: There was a drop in temperature after the rain.

june.e: My daughter is to get married in June.
june.c: 我女儿打算在六月结婚。

blood.e: It made my blood boil to hear that.
blood.c: 听到这个让我感觉热血沸腾。

march.e: Miss March gave me an English dictionary.
march.c: 三月小姐给了我一本英语词典。

push.e: The politician pushed for reform by denouncing the corruption of the government officials.
push.c: 政治家以揭露政府官员的腐败来推动改革。

size.e: Do you have this in a bigger size?
size.c: 你有比这个再大一点的尺寸吗?

introduce.e: You should have introduced yourself to the girl.
introduce.c: 你应该向那个女孩自我介绍的。

garden.e: The ball bounded away into our neighbor's garden.
garden.c: 球弹呀弹呀的弹进了邻家的花园。

store.e: There used to be a store right here.

environment.e: We ought to do our best not to pollute our environment.
environment.c: 我们应该尽力不要污染环境。

sound.e: I love the sound of children laughing.
sound.c: 我喜欢孩子们笑的声音。

note.e: Note that the maximum doesn't always exist.
note.c: 注意，最大值不总是存在的。

success.e: Honesty is the primary reason for his success.
success.c: 诚实是他成功的主要原因。

enter.e: No student is allowed to enter the room.
enter.c: 学生不准进入这个房间。

arrive.e: We arrived at a small town in Hokkaido.
arrive.c: 我们到达了北海道的一个小镇。

natural.e: It comes natural to him to speak French.
natural.c: 说法语对他来说很自然。

list.e: His name is not on the list.

race.e: The weather will delay the start of the race.
race.c: 因为天气的关系，赛跑比赛将会延迟。

relation.e: South Korea established diplomatic relations with Syria.
relation.c: 韩国与叙利亚建立外交关系。

labour.e: He is reaping the fruits of his labor.
labour.c: 他在收获他的劳动果实。

dead.e: Is the snake alive or dead?
dead.c: 这条蛇是活的还是死的？

capital.e: Write your name in capital letters.
capital.c: 写下你名字的大写字母。

round.e: The teacher said that the earth is round.

tv.e: I watched the news on TV after supper.
tv.c: 我吃过晚饭后打开电视看了一会儿新闻。

article.e: I've boldfaced the articles that I found interesting.
article.c: 我加粗了我觉得有趣的文章。

hotel.e: It was dark when I reached the hotel.
hotel.c: 我到旅馆的时候，天已经黑了。

east.e: The wind is blowing from the east.

forward.e: One step forward is a step towards civility.

save.e: The bridge saved us a lot of time.
save.c: 那条桥为我们节省了不少时间。

village.e: We've become a mockery to the whole village.
village.c: 我们成了整个村庄的笑柄。

station.e: He will have to go to the station.

nine.e: He did not come back until nine o'clock.

treatment.e: You should stay in the hospital for treatment.
treatment.c: 你应该留在医院，接受治疗。

beyond.e: The beauty of the scene was beyond description.
beyond.c: 那里的景色美得无法以笔墨形容。

cup.e: He dropped the cup and broke it.
cup.c: 他把杯子掉到地板上打碎了。

protect.e: We should tell children how to protect themselves.
protect.c: 我们应该告诉孩子怎么保护自己。

manage.e: He doesn't have the ability to manage that group.
manage.c: 他没有能力去管理那个团队。

serious.e: In China, software piracy is a serious issue.
serious.c: 在中国，软件盗版是一个很严重的问题。

whatever.e: I'll do whatever you want me to do.
whatever.c: 无论你要我做什么，我都会去做的。

difficulty.e: We have to cope with hosts of difficulties.
difficulty.c: 我们要面对许多的困难。

machine.e: The vending machines are over there.

modern.e: I like classical music more than modern music.
modern.c: 相比现代音乐，我更喜欢古典音乐。

degree.e: To what degree are you interested in baseball?
degree.c: 你喜欢棒球到什么程度？

answer.e: Thousands of people wanted to know the answer.
answer.c: 成千上万的人想要知道答案。

left.e: The doors on the left side will open.

mile.e: The town is two miles away from the coast.
mile.c: 那小镇离岸边有两英里。

compare.e: He compared his car to the new model.
compare.c: 他拿他的车和新款车作比较。

lady.e: Please call a taxi for this lady.
lady.c: 请为这位女士叫辆出租车。

prepare.e: I don't plan to hang out tonight. I need to prepare for my lessons.
prepare.c: 我今晚不准备出去玩，我要预备功课。

disease.e: Some diseases are caused by a defective gene.
disease.c: 一些疾病的产生原因是基因缺陷。

final.e: Most students are preparing for the final exams.
final.c: 大多数学生都在为期末考试复习。

task.e: Despite a lot of difficulties, he still completed the task.
task.c: 虽然困难重重，他还是完成了这个任务。

ability.e: He made no progress in his speaking ability.
ability.c: 他说话的能力没有任何的进步。

behaviour.e: Your behavior is creating a lot of problems.
behaviour.c: 你的行为引起了许多的麻烦。

wonder.e: They wondered why they'd been invited.
wonder.c: 他们想知道为什么邀请他们

science.e: Science begins when you ask why and how.
science.c: 为何如何？你疑问的当下就是科学的开端。

television.e: Did you watch the soccer game on television?
television.c: 你在电视上看足球赛了吗？

box.e: There are some empty bottles in the box.

feeling.e: I feel smart... Pity... It's just a feeling...
feeling.c: 我感觉自己很聪明。。。可惜。。。这只是个感觉。。。

pretty.e: Long long ago, there lived a pretty girl.
pretty.c: 很久很久以前住着一个漂亮的小女孩。

everybody.e: Everybody wished he had been elected governor.
everybody.c: 每个人都希望他当选州长。

hall.e: Can we speak in the hall?
hall.c: 我们能在走廊里说话吗？

skill.e: Algeria needs to train its public sector employees on new technologies, communication skills, and customer service.
skill.c: 阿尔及利亚需要对其公共部门员工进行新技术、沟通技巧和客服方面的培训。

horse.e: Do you know how to ride a horse?

lay.e: A beautiful lake lay just beyond the forest.
lay.c: 森林外有一个美丽的湖泊。

message.e: Would you like to leave him a message?

outside.e: All at once we heard a shot outside.
outside.c: 我们突然听见外面传来了一下枪声。

normal.e: Stop seeing me as a "normal" person!
normal.c: 不要再把我当成“正常”人！

forget.e: Don't forget smoking is bad for your health.
forget.c: 不要忘记吸烟对你的健康有害。

army.e: A great number of citizens went into the army.
army.c: 许多老百姓加入了军队。

glass.e: How come your fingerprints are on this glass?
glass.c: 你的指纹怎么会在这个玻璃杯上?

total.e: The total expense for the project amounts to one hundred million yen.
total.c: 计划的总开支为一亿円。

miss.e: Miss, are there any available rooms for tonight?
miss.c: 小姐，今天晚上有没有空房间？

anyway.e: We're all going to die anyway.
anyway.c: 不管怎样，我们所有人都将死。

avoid.e: Try to avoid making any more trouble.
avoid.c: 尽量避免制造任何更多的麻烦。

bill.e: The baby tore up a ten-dollar bill.
bill.c: 这个小婴孩撕掉了一张十美元的钞票。

express.e: I don't know how to express my thanks.
express.c: 我不知道如何表达我的谢意。

gun.e: We discussed gun control in social studies class.
gun.c: 我们上社会课的时候谈到了枪械管制的问题。

suppose.e: Where do you suppose you'll spend your vacation?
suppose.c: 你认为你会到哪儿度假？

finish.e: I'll finish it as quickly as I can.

duty.e: He has completely lost all sense of duty.

july.e: One day in July, we went to the sea.
july.c: 七月的某一天，我们去了海边。

truth.e: Speak the truth, even if your voice shakes.
truth.c: 即使您的声音颤抖，也要说出事实。

song.e: This song is very popular in Japan.
song.c: 这首歌曲在日本很受欢迎。

park.e: We have a parking lot for the customers.
park.c: 我们有一个顾客专用的停车场。

check.e: You need to get your eyes checked.

dark.e: No wonder we associate bats with dark places.
dark.c: 难怪我们会把蝙蝠和黑暗的地方联想在一起了。

discussion.e: After three hours of discussion we got nowhere.
discussion.c: 我们讨论了三个小时，但却一点进展也没有。

laugh.e: All at once they began to laugh.
laugh.c: 他们突然一起大笑了起来。

guess.e: I guess I'm never going to get married.

chairman.e: They made him the chairman of a club.
chairman.c: 他们选他做俱乐部主席。

visit.e: If he were here, he would visit us.
visit.c: 如果他在这里, 他就会来拜访我们。

rock.e: Rocks are beautifully arranged in the Japanese-style garden.
rock.c: 石头被美丽得放置在日式庭园里。

sorry.e: I'm sorry for your not having come with us.
sorry.c: 我很遗憾您没有和我们一起来。

encourage.e: Learning should not be forced, but rather encouraged.
encourage.c: 学习不该被强迫，而是该被鼓励。

stone.e: He threw a stone at the big dog.
stone.c: 他朝着大狗扔了块石头。

conference.e: The conference is to be held in Tokyo.

memory.e: She had begun to recede in my memory.
memory.c: 她开始在我的记忆中消散。

card.e: Thank you for sending me a nice card.
card.c: 谢谢你寄给我的一张漂亮的卡片。

smile.e: Her smile indicates that she has forgiven me.
smile.c: 她脸上的笑容，代表她已经原谅我了。

seat.e: He offered his seat to an old woman.
seat.c: 他把座位让给了一个老婆婆。

post.e: I'll call by the post office on the way home.
post.c: 我回家时会顺道去一去邮政局。

spring.e: Which do you like better, spring or autumn?
spring.c: 春天和秋天，你更喜欢哪个？

mention.e: The radio didn't mention the incident.
mention.c: 电台没有提到这个事故。

improve.e: I would like to improve my English pronunciation.
improve.c: 我想改善我的英语发音。

radio.e: He knows how to make a radio.

imagine.e: Today no one can imagine a life without television.
imagine.c: 今天没有人能想像一个没有电视的生活。

direction.e: You have a really good sense of direction.

tonight.e: I will put up at my friend's tonight.
tonight.c: 今晚我将在朋友家过夜。

basic.e: This law will deprive us of our basic rights.
basic.c: 这项法律会剥夺我们的基本权利。

huge.e: The huge tanker has just left the dock.
huge.c: 一艘巨大的液货船刚刚启航。

successful.e: So far we have been quite successful.
successful.c: 到目前为止，我们还是相当成功的。

yourself.e: Did you do your homework by yourself?
yourself.c: 你自己做回家作业的吗?

discover.e: The explorers discovered a skeleton in the cave.
discover.c: 探险家们在洞穴里发现了骸骨。

popular.e: No pro golfer in Japan is as popular as Jumbo Ozaki.
popular.c: 尾崎将司是日本最受欢迎的专业高尔夫球手。

traditional.e: Their traditional life style no longer exists.
traditional.c: 他们传统的生活方式不再存在。

peace.e: Our ultimate goal is to establish world peace.
peace.c: 我们的究极目标是树立世界和平。

refuse.e: I don't know whether to accept or refuse.
refuse.c: 我不知道应该接受还是拒绝。

prevent.e: These measures can prevent the disease from spreading.
prevent.c: 这些措施可以预防疾病蔓延。

fly.e: Do you ever dream about flying through the sky?
fly.c: 你曾经梦想在天空飞翔吗？

heavy.e: The weight of our unspoken words is heavy.
heavy.c: 我们未曾说出口的话，份量沉重。

regard.e: They regard him as the best doctor in town.
regard.c: 他们把他视为城里最好的医生。

camera.e: The camera has been borrowed by someone else.

pupil.e: How many pupils are there in your school?
pupil.c: 你的学校有多少个学生？

weight.e: You worry about your weight too much.

direct.e: Is this the direct way to the Prado?
direct.c: 这条路是不是直接通往普拉多博物馆？

advice.e: He gave her a piece of advice.

trip.e: She set out on a trip last week.

inside.e: We should look inside this house as well.
inside.c: 我们还应该看下这个房子的内部。

september.e: In my family there are two birthdays in September.
september.c: 我家九月有两人过生日。

library.e: Tomorrow, I'm going to study at the library.

advantage.e: You have the advantage of a good education.
advantage.c: 你受过良好教育，这是你的优势。

worry.e: Worrying doesn't take away tomorrow's concerns, but it does take away today's power.
worry.c: 烦恼带不走明天的忧虑, 但却拿走了今天的力量。

surface.e: One third of the earth's surface is desert.
surface.c: 地球表面的三分之一是沙漠。

america.e: My father often goes to America on business.
america.c: 我爸爸经常去美国出差。

immediately.e: He commanded me to leave the room immediately.
immediately.c: 他命令我立刻离开这个房间。

deep.e: I don't know how deep the lake is.
deep.c: 我不知道这个湖有多深。

worth.e: If it is worth doing, do it well.
worth.c: 如果事情值得做就值得做好。

edge.e: A great Empire, like a great Cake, is most easily diminished at the Edges.
edge.c: 一个伟大的帝国, 就像是一个大蛋糕, 最容易消失的地方就在边缘。

trouble.e: May I trouble you to shut the window?
trouble.c: 可以麻烦你把窗关了吗？

island.e: The island lies to the west of Japan.
island.c: 这个岛屿位于日本的西边。

january.e: January is the first month of the year.
january.c: 一月是一年之中的头一个月。

fear.e: He studied hard for fear he should fail.
fear.c: 因为害怕不及格，他努力学习。

shoulder.e: She rested her head on her mother's shoulder.
shoulder.c: 她把头枕在母亲的肩膀上。

useful.e: All models are wrong, but some are useful.
useful.c: 所有的模型都有错，不过有些还是有用的。

depend.e: His answer depends on his mood.
depend.c: 他的答案要看他的心情而定。

middle.e: The library is in the middle of the city.

sunday.e: Meet you there on Sunday morning. Can't wait.
sunday.c: 星期日上午在那边和你碰头。都等不及了。

spouse.e: Tom found a wonderful spouse in Mary.
spouse.c: 汤姆认识了玛莉这么个好老婆。

sodium.e: Sodium bicarbonate is commonly known as baking soda.
sodium.c: 碳酸氢钠通常被称为小苏打。

riot.e: There was only one warden on duty when the riot started.
riot.c: 暴动开始时只有一位监狱长值班。

extract.e: She extracts beautiful colors from turmeric.
extract.c: 她从姜黄里提取美丽色彩。

dedicate.e: Have you ever dedicated a song to the orphans?
dedicate.c: 你有没有给孤儿献上一首歌呢？

conceive.e: I can't conceive of living without him.
conceive.c: 我无法想像生命中没有他。

engagement.e: I congratulate you on your engagement.

counterpart.e: The Fuzhou Zoo in China's Fujian Province has done more than its counterparts in training pandas.
counterpart.c: 中国福建省福州市动物园在训练大熊猫方面做得比它的同行多。

marvellous.e: A marvellous sunset greeted me on the coast.
marvellous.c: 美丽的日落在海岸迎接我。

amid.e: There's a fear that the snow will strengthen amid the strong winter pressure pattern.
amid.c: 人们担心在强劲的冬季气压模式下，降雪量会增加。

trader.e: International traders are struggling just to get by.
trader.c: 国际贸易商正在努力度过难关。

diagnose.e: People “diagnosed” with “Internet addiction” are nearly always diagnosed with other difficulties as well.
diagnose.c: 诊断患有“网络成瘾症”的人差不多总是也有其他的困难。

envisage.e: These industrial parks were envisaged as havens for domestic and foreign investors.
envisage.c: 这些工业园区被设想为国内外投资者的避风港。

concession.e: Yuri and Martha made concessions for each other.

concede.e: England’s goalkeeper was criticized for the amount of goals he conceded.
concede.c: 英格兰的守门员因为自己失球过多而被批评。

clash.e: Every now and then they clash over their differences.
clash.c: 他们有时候有矛盾冲突

entity.e: Many entities from other dimensions speak to me.
entity.c: 许多来自其他维度的实体对我说话。

update.e: My PC is in the middle of an update.

exploration.e: I like how WHAT THE CAR? combines racing with fun puzzle gameplay and exploration.
exploration.c: 我喜欢《WHAT THE CAR?》将赛车与有趣的益智游戏和探索相结合。

thesis.e: Are you preparing for your thesis defense?

commonwealth.e: Barbados is a member of the Commonwealth.
commonwealth.c: 巴巴多斯是英联邦成员。

subsidiary.e: Overseas subsidiaries are putting out top-of the-line products.
subsidiary.c: 海外子公司正在推出顶级产品。

incidence.e: The angle of incidence equals the angle of reflection.
incidence.c: 入射光全部被反射的最小的 入射角 。

recipient.e: Don't flip-flop the addresses of the sender and recipient!
recipient.c: 不要把寄件人、收件人地址的姓名填反了！

bias.e: People tend to look at others with bias.
bias.c: 人们趋向于带着偏见看待他人。

tribute.e: This is a tribute to my adoring fans.
tribute.c: 这是对我崇拜的粉丝的致敬。

minimize.e: By building sustainable cities, policymakers can support social and economic development, while minimizing environmental damage.
minimize.c: 通过构建可持续发展城市，决策者可以支持社会经济发展，同时最大限度地减少环境损失。 在城市化的同时加强管理而避免事后亡羊补牢是发展中国家领导人不应错过的机遇。

edit.e: Edit your work better before you submit it, it's sloppy.
edit.c: 提交工作内容之前请仔细检查，这里有疏忽的地方。

casualty.e: They were, so to speak, casualties of war.
casualty.c: 可以说，他们是战争的牺牲品。

tightly.e: She held on to my hand tightly.

contemplate.e: He's contemplating the complexity of contemporary life.
contemplate.c: 他思考着现代生活的复杂性。

remainder.e: The remainder of the evening was peaceful.
remainder.c: 那天晚上剩下的时间过得很平静。

intervene.e: We take health for granted until illness intervenes.
intervene.c: 我们视健康为理所当然, 直到疾病侵袭。

diminish.e: The population of this country is gradually diminishing.
diminish.c: 这个国家的人口正在逐渐减少。

prevention.e: An ounce of prevention is worth a pound of cure.

metropolitan.e: He focused his business on the metropolitan area.
metropolitan.c: 他将业务重点放在大都市地区。

sensitivity.e: He had no sensitivity for how I felt.
sensitivity.c: 他对我的感受毫不留情。

inventory.e: Simply put, we must complete the global inventory of species. Now.
inventory.c: 简而言之，我们必须完善全球物种目录。 就从现在开始。

exceptional.e: I like this television. The sound is exceptional.
exceptional.c: 我喜欢这台电视。声音出类拔萃。

magnitude.e: A massive earthquake of magnitude 8.8 hit the Japanese islands today.
magnitude.c: 今天，8.8级的强大地震袭击了日本的岛屿。

hostage.e: The hostages will be released tomorrow.

popularity.e: His first work gained great popularity among people.
popularity.c: 他的处女作受到了大家的极大欢迎。

supervision.e: Don't swim in deep water without adult supervision.
supervision.c: 在没有成人监督的情况下，请勿在深水中游泳。

alien.e: I swear, I saw an alien!
alien.c: 我发誓我看到了外星人。

cling.e: Exchange rates are another wild card. Asian central banks are still nervously clinging to the dollar.
cling.c: 随着债务的增加和持续的经济萧条，我们相信，越来越多的国家会采取金融紧缩，高通货膨胀以及债务部分免除等三种方法，也可能是以上方法的组合。 不幸的是，结束2000年危机的方式将不会是很乐观的。

photography.e: I have an interest in photography.

execution.e: A stay of execution was ordered at the eleventh hour.
execution.c: 缓期执行在最后关头决定了下来。

similarity.e: The similarity between the two persons is astonishing.
similarity.c: 两人的相似之处令人惊讶。

incur.e: You do not want to incur the wrath of God.
incur.c: 你不想招致上帝的愤怒。

continental.e: They serve a continental breakfast in this hotel.
continental.c: 他们在这家酒店供应欧陆式早餐。

romance.e: Can you recommend a romance novel for me?
romance.c: 有什么言情小说推荐吗？

annually.e: Do you know how many people starve to death in the world annually?
annually.c: 你知不知道全世界每年有多少人饿死呀？

ranch.e: Gustavo went to the ranch to help out.

verbal.e: I don't need your verbal gentleness.
verbal.c: 我不需要你口头上的温柔。

coastal.e: Chinese coastal cities are generally more developed than the inland ones.
coastal.c: 中国大陆的沿海城市普遍比内陆城市发达。

substantially.e: The stability of Chinese economy is substantially overestimated.
substantially.c: 中国经济的稳定性被大大高估了。

constituent.e: The senator avowed his devotion to his constituents.
constituent.c: 这位参议员承认他对选民的忠诚。

sentiment.e: Anti-Chinese sentiment is on the rise in Myanmar.
sentiment.c: 缅甸反华情绪正在增长。

divine.e: To err is human, to forgive divine.

interim.e: In the interim, I will serve as chairman.
interim.c: 在此期间，我将担任董事长。

inspiration.e: My mother was an angel and an inspiration to me.
inspiration.c: 我的母亲是一位天使，也是我的灵感来源。

parameter.e: The general parameters of a long-term, two-state agreement are well known.
parameter.c: 一个长期的、巴以两国共存的协议总体范围是众所周知的。

equilibrium.e: We could apply the theory of punctuated equilibrium to languages.
equilibrium.c: 我们可以把间断平衡理论应用到语言上。

quest.e: Gulliver traveled in quest of adventure.
quest.c: 格列佛为寻求探险而旅行。

slap.e: She gave him a slap in the face.

toxic.e: Populism rests on a toxic triad: denial of complexity, anti-pluralism, and a crooked version of representation.
toxic.c: 民粹主义的基础是有毒三元组：否定复杂性、反多元主义和扭曲代表形式。

grief.e: She was filled with deep grief to hear of her father's sudden death.
grief.c: 她得知父亲突然离世，不禁心如刀割。

donate.e: How much money do you donate every year?

invariably.e: Last summer's sky was invariably grey.
invariably.c: 去年夏天的天空总是灰色的。

forthcoming.e: His forthcoming novel will be out next month.
forthcoming.c: 他即将出版的小说将于下个月出版。

coincide.e: The date of the festival coincides with that of the exam.
coincide.c: 节日和考试碰巧在同一天。

shrimp.e: I want half a kilo of fresh shrimps.
shrimp.c: 我想要半公斤新鲜的虾。

formulate.e: I cannot coherently formulate words without coffee.
formulate.c: 不喝咖啡我就没法连贯地组织语言。

correspondence.e: We have carried on a correspondence for years.

costume.e: Sami was the only one who could fit into the costume.
costume.c: 萨米是唯一一个能穿上这件衣服的人。

bug.c: 一些程式错误被改正了。

verdict.e: The jury's guilty verdict gave rise to widespread debate.
verdict.c: 陪审团作出的犯罪判决激起了很大的争论。

deem.e: Each age has deemed the new-born year the fittest time for festal cheer.
deem.c: 岁岁皆为新生之年，都值得好好庆祝。

bankruptcy.e: The banks are on the verge of bankruptcy.

collaboration.e: Let us put those timeless, old-tech skills of far-sightedness and collaboration together with new technology.
collaboration.c: 让我们把永恒、古老的长远技术合作与新技术相结合。 如果成功，现在这一代非洲领导人将有独一无二的机会保护后代免于气候灾难、他们还能让所有人享受能源带来的好处并建设共同繁荣。

prey.e: Your random firing will scare away the prey.
prey.c: 你胡乱打枪，会吓跑猎物的。

patrol.e: He fled when he saw the police patrol.
patrol.c: 他看到警察巡逻队就逃跑了。

predecessor.e: Floppy disks are the predecessor of hard disks.

revelation.e: The company is still smarting from the revelations.
revelation.c: 公司至今仍为那些被曝光的内幕而痛苦。

haul.e: All this junk needs to be hauled away.
haul.c: 所有这些垃圾都需要被拖走。

hitherto.e: The history of all hitherto existing societies is the history of class struggles.
hitherto.c: 迄今为止所有现存社会的历史都是阶级斗争的历史。

coffin.e: Oleg came out of one of the coffins.
coffin.c: 奥列格从其中一个棺材里出来。

notable.e: The trigonometric functions satisfy a wide array of notable algebraic identities.
notable.c: 三角函数满足各种代数恒等式。

immune.e: Everybody is immune to smallpox nowadays.
immune.c: 现今每个人都对天花免疫了。

ass.e: It's such a pain in the ass.

exotic.e: Hedgehogs need to be taken to exotic vets.
exotic.c: 刺猬需要被带到异国情调的兽医那里。

clip.e: Do they clip the sheep every year?
clip.c: 他们每年都给羊剪毛吗？

recruitment.e: The recruitment team looked for promising employees.
recruitment.c: 招聘团队寻找有前途的员工。

documentary.e: He recorded a documentary and gave it to me.
documentary.c: 他录了一个纪录片给我。

rally.e: You can attend school assemblies and pep rallies.
rally.c: 你可以参加学校集会和动员大会。

geographical.e: Algeria is in a geographical Goldilocks zone.
geographical.c: 阿尔及利亚位于地理上的金发姑娘区。

manipulate.e: Some teachers instinctively know how to play “favorites” to manipulate the other students.
manipulate.c: 有些老师本能地知道怎么去利用“偏心”去控制其他学生。

tragic.e: They both cried after hearing the tragic news.
tragic.c: 听到这件悲剧，他俩尽皆哭泣。

ambitious.e: The difference between bragging and being ambitious is miniscule.
ambitious.c: 吹嘘与雄心的差别甚小。

circulation.e: He works for a newspaper with a large circulation.
circulation.c: 他为一份印刷量很大的报纸工作。

disturbance.e: Stefan heard a sudden disturbance in the water.
disturbance.c: Stefan突然听到水中有一声骚动。

tighten.e: Critics are coming down hard on tightened economic restrictions.
tighten.c: 对严格限制经济的批评蜂拥而来。

aesthetic.e: What is it that satisfies your aesthetic sense?
aesthetic.c: 是什么满足了你的审美感？

rejection.e: He needs to stop obsessing over that rejection.
rejection.c: 他得停止纠结那次被拒绝的事。

accomplishment.e: We are the heirs to their accomplishments. We are their debtors.
accomplishment.c: 我们是他们的成就的继承者。 我们欠着他们的。 我们无法还清这笔欠他们的债务。 我们唯能永远铭记。

minimal.e: Multilateralism requires minimal consensus on global rules and norms among all major powers.
minimal.c: 多边主义要求所有大国就全球规则及规范达成最低限度的共识。 有能力阻止或否决国际倡议的国家越多，多边主义就越难以实现 — — 主要国家也越不愿意展开合作。 在以主权担忧和战略竞争为特色的新兴多极世界里，在解决全球问题上取得进展将比以往更加困难 — — 而这有可能产生破坏性的后果。

commence.e: The surgeon scrubbed up before commencing the operation.
commence.c: 外科医生在开始手术前进行了擦洗。

maturity.e: Age doesn't lead to maturity, unless you're a cheese.
maturity.c: 年龄并不会带来成熟，除非你是一块奶酪。

scramble.e: Would you like some scrambled egg?

precede.e: The third quarter GNP growth was 1% over the preceding quarter.
precede.c: 第三季国民生产总值较上一季成长了1％。

banker.e: Why, then, are so many central bankers so worried about low inflation rates?
banker.c: 那么，为何如此多的央行如此担忧低通胀率呢？

momentum.e: This is due to conservation of angular momentum.
momentum.c: 这是由于角动量的守恒。

irony.e: Now, that, too, would be an exquisite irony.
irony.c: 如今，这也会是一个绝妙的讽刺。

interact.e: You should interact with the local culture more, to better understand some traditions.
interact.c: 你应该多接触本文化，多了解一些传统习俗。

charm.e: She thought of herself as being charming enough.
charm.c: 她认为她自己够迷人的了。

alteration.e: Can you make some alterations to this product?
alteration.c: 您可以对此产品进行一些更改吗？

vein.e: When he shouted, the veins in his neck stood out clearly.
vein.c: 他大喊的时候，脖子上青筋暴起。

petition.e: We hope you all will sign this petition.
petition.c: 我们希望你们都能在这份请愿书上签名。

foster.e: This song was written by Foster.
foster.c: 这首歌曲是由福斯特所写的。

expedition.e: They went on an expedition to the Antarctic.

plea.e: I plead you to tell me the truth.

commodity.c: 日常用品变得愈加贵了。

tile.e: How many tiles do you need?

shove.e: Shove a stick up your ass.
shove.c: 把一根棍子塞进你的屁股里。

moor.e: The flock was placed in a small moor.
moor.c: 羊群被放置在一个小沼泽中。

regiment.e: Which regiment do you belong to?

handicap.e: Having no will is the worst handicap.
handicap.c: 没有愿望是最大的障碍。

unprecedented.e: The Tokyo stock market recorded an unprecedented loss.
unprecedented.c: 东京股市录得前所未有的亏损。

mobility.e: The concept of social mobility is a lie.
mobility.c: 社会流动的概念是一个谎言。

texture.e: Line art emphasizes form and outline, over color, shading, and texture.
texture.c: 线条艺术强调形式和轮廓，而不是颜色、阴影和纹理。

damn.e: I don't give a damn about my CV.
damn.c: 我根本不在乎我的简历。

bureaucracy.e: Algeria needs to get rid of its bureaucracy.
bureaucracy.c: 阿尔及利亚需要摆脱官僚主义。

composer.e: Which of the composers do you like best?

empirical.e: Empirical data is based solely on observation.
empirical.c: 经验数据完全基于观察。

hike.c: 齐莉只在白天徒步旅行。

confrontation.e: Everybody knows that Cold War is the confrontation between two nations.
confrontation.c: 是人都知道冷战是两国的对峙。

thanksgiving.e: It's a custom to have turkey at Thanksgiving.
thanksgiving.c: 感恩节吃火鸡是一种习俗。

onwards.e: I will follow your advice fully from here onwards.
onwards.c: 接下来该怎么做，我完全听从您的吩咐。

vocal.e: Public feeling against air pollution has at last become vocal.
vocal.c: 公众终于对关于空气污染的意见直言不讳了。

deprive.e: No one can deprive of your human rights.
deprive.c: 没有人能剥夺你的人权。

terrain.e: The rugged terrain made the troops' advance difficult.
terrain.c: 地面高低不平，给部队前进带来了困难。

compact.e: I want a compact car with an air conditioner.
compact.c: 我想要一辆有空调的小型车。

deploy.e: The US deployed its own troops to Iraq.
deploy.c: 美国在伊拉克部署了自己的军队。

embark.e: The old couple embarked on a tour around the world.
embark.c: 老夫妇出发去环游世界了。

distract.e: Don't distract me while I am studying.
distract.c: 我学习的时候不要打扰我。

summon.e: He gained the power to summon ghost trains.
summon.c: 他获得了召唤幽灵列车的能力。

ecosystem.e: California’s enclave of tech companies remains the crown jewel of entrepreneurial ecosystems.
ecosystem.c: 加利福尼亚高科技公司的周边依然是创业生态系统皇冠上的明珠。 但国际创新势力正日趋意识到随着硅谷估值的飞速上涨，精通技术投资者真正的天堂或许在美国国外才可以找到。

revive.e: A spring rain revived the flower.
revive.c: 一场春雨使花朵回复了生气。

stall.e: For years he has been at the market every Tuesday morning with his fish stall.
stall.c: 他在街市卖鱼卖了许多年了，这些年来每逢星期二都会在街市见到他。

validity.e: You shouldn't deny the validity of everything she did just because of a single mistake.
validity.c: 你不能因为她所犯下的一个错误就否定她所做的一切。

suppress.e: Heathers help to suppress weeds in your garden.
suppress.c: 石楠花有助于抑制花园里的杂草。

neighbouring.e: My attention was grabbed by a conversation at the neighbouring table.
neighbouring.c: 隔壁桌的对话吸引了我的注意。

sneak.c: 汤姆鬼鬼祟祟地溜近了玛丽身后。

entail.e: The undertaking entailed great expense upon the government.
entail.c: 这项事业给政府带来了巨大的开支。

motorway.e: The toilets at motorway service stations are often very dirty.
motorway.c: 服务站的卫生间大多很脏。

thereafter.e: Thereafter we heard no more from him.
thereafter.c: 从那时以后，我们再也没听到他的任何音讯。

dreadful.e: The consequences of Sendai's earthquake were dreadful!
dreadful.c: 仙台地震的结果很恐怖。

fling.e: She claimed the affair was just a fling.
fling.c: 她声称那段暧昧只是一时兴起。

manuscript.e: He showed me the manuscript of his new play.
manuscript.c: 他给我看了他最新剧的底稿。

rim.e: Mary took an egg and cracked it open on the rim of the bowl.
rim.c: 玛丽娅拿了一个鸡蛋，并将它在碗沿上敲开。

allied.e: Germany was allied with Italy in World War II.
allied.c: 在二战中，德国与意大利结盟。

blink.e: The firefighters put out the fire in the blink of an eye.
blink.c: 消防员一眨眼的功夫就把火给灭了。

yacht.e: The yacht sailed around a buoy.

faction.e: The two factions gang up with each other.

intact.e: The buildings were still intact after the flood.
intact.c: 洪水过后，建筑物仍然完好无损。

diesel.e: This heating equipment uses diesel as fuel.
diesel.c: 这个取暖装置用柴油作为燃料。

fossil.e: What I have in my hand is a fossil seashell.
fossil.c: 在我手里的是一个贝壳化石。

butt.e: Don't throw cigarette butts on the ground. Cockroaches might get cancer.
butt.c: 别把烟头往地上扔，要不然蟑螂会得癌症的。

lily.e: A smell of lilies filled the room.
lily.c: 百合的香气充满了整个房间。

patron.e: She was a patron of the arts.

municipal.e: The municipal rubbish dump is full of rats.
municipal.c: 市政垃圾场到处都是老鼠。

supervise.e: I want to talk to your supervising officer.

misery.e: His illness caused her great misery.

fringe.e: She cut her fringe in a blunt style.
fringe.c: 她削减了她的边缘在一个生硬的风格。

cruise.e: The straits were too narrow for the cruise ship.
cruise.c: 这个海峡对游艇来说太窄了。

merge.e: The Mitsubishi Bank merged with the Bank of Tokyo.
merge.c: 三菱银行和东京银行合并了。

impulse.e: I felt an impulse to cry out loud.

brutal.e: The hills were brutal and tricky to climb.

obstinate.c: 他年纪越大变得越顽固。

tenable.e: This thesis is no longer tenable.
tenable.c: 这个论点已经站不住脚了。

deferential.e: Ziri was always deferential around Rima's mother.
deferential.c: 齐里在里玛的母亲面前总是恭恭敬敬的。

provost.e: Is a provost like a mayor?
provost.c: 教务长是不是就像市长？

quench.e: Do you have a drink to help quench my thirst?
quench.c: 你有没有什么喝的给我解渴吗？

ventilate.e: He opened the window to ventilate the room.
ventilate.c: 他打开窗户给房间通风。

corrode.e: Normalizing hate speech corrodes the moral fabric of society.
corrode.c: 对仇恨言论的纵容会腐蚀社会的道德根基。

discontented.e: They told me that they were discontented.
discontented.c: 他们告诉我，他们心里很不满。

interconnect.e: Tatoeba is really multilingual. All the languages are interconnected.
interconnect.c: Tatoeba确实是多语言的。所有的语言都互相关联。

fission.e: What's the difference between fission and fusion?
fission.c: 裂变和聚变有什么区别？

haughty.e: I am haughty and you are an idiot.
haughty.c: 我傲慢自大，而你是个白痴。

earthenware.e: What's the difference between glass and earthenware?
earthenware.c: 玻璃和陶器有什么区别？

yielding.e: He went out, yielding to a sudden impulse.
yielding.c: 他拗不过一阵突然的冲动，走了出去。

faultless.e: A faultless plan is stifling, isn't it?
faultless.c: 一个完美无缺的计划让人喘不过气，不是吗？

deflection.e: The general theory of relativity predicted the deflection of starlight by the Sun.
deflection.c: 广义相对论预言了太阳对星光的偏折。

sorrowful.e: You know I am a bit sorrowful.

inversely.e: The length of a marriage is inversely proportional to the cost of the wedding.
inversely.c: 婚姻的长度与婚宴的花费负相关。

thoughtless.e: Thoughtless speech may give rise to great mischief.
thoughtless.c: 不假思索的话可能惹出大麻烦。

dynamo.e: FC Dynamo Kyiv are presenting their new kit.
dynamo.c: 基辅迪纳摩足球俱乐部正在展示他们的新球衣。

rascal.e: You rascal, why are you complaining so much?
rascal.c: 你这个小淘气，干嘛抱怨这么多？

slander.e: She loudly said every slander imaginable about me.
slander.c: 她大声地说着关于我的各种诽谤之词。

saturn.e: Saturn is the second largest planet in the Solar System.
saturn.c: 土星是太阳系中第二大的行星。

excrete.e: I occasionally excrete concrete: this is not strange.
excrete.c: 我偶尔会排出混凝土，这并不奇怪。

deafen.e: The roar of the heavy guns was deafening.

demography.e: Due to its geography and demography, conquering Panjshir by force is considered extremely difficult.
demography.c: 由于地理和人口因素，武力征服潘杰希尔被认为极其困难。

thrifty.e: He is thrifty, not to say stingy.
thrifty.c: 他勤俭节约，甚至是小气的。

outermost.e: The exosphere is the outermost layer of our atmosphere.
outermost.c: 外逸层是我们大气层的最外层。

oxidize.e: As it oxidizes, the color turns blue and finally becomes a brilliant reddish-purple hue.
oxidize.c: 随氧化变成蓝色，最终呈现出鲜艳的红紫色。

dully.e: From time to time lightning flashes, and thunder rumbles dully.
dully.c: 不时有闪电划过，雷声低沉地轰隆作响。

regenerative.e: Love arouses regenerative energies in us.
regenerative.c: 爱会唤起我们体内再生的能量。

curative.e: The brain is the center of all curative energy.
curative.c: 大脑是一切疗愈能量的中心。

insulator.e: It's a great insulator, keeping hot foods hot and cold foods cold.
insulator.c: 它是很好的隔热材料，能让热的食物保温、冷的食物保冷。

disorient.c: 汤姆说我看起来很迷茫。

preset.c: 你随时可以预先设定好。

thresh.e: Threshing cereals creates a lot of dust.
thresh.c: 脱粒谷物会扬起很多灰尘。

miser.e: The miser opened the box to find his money stolen.
miser.c: 这个守财奴打开了盒子，发现他的钱被偷了。

tropic.e: There are only two seasons in the tropics.
tropic.c: 在热带地区只有两个季节。

metallurgy.e: Is Boston a major center for metallurgy?
metallurgy.c: 波士顿是冶金业的主要中心吗？

kilowatt.e: How many kilowatts does the average home use per year?
kilowatt.c: 一个普通家庭一年要用多少千瓦电？

impoverish.e: More than 75% of them fear that technology impoverishes the traditional French language.
impoverish.c: 他们其中的 75 ％ 以上都担心技术导致传统法语的衰落。

hurrah.e: Hurrah to the King of Swing!

entreat.e: I entreat you to go and see him.

sophisticate.e: A vast and sophisticated system is usually based on a few simple rules.
sophisticate.c: 庞大而精妙的体系往往建立在几个简单的规则之上。

ohm.e: The ohm is the unit of measure for electrical resistance.

solvable.e: Food insecurity is a solvable problem.
solvable.c: 粮食不安全是一个可以解决的问题。

bewilder.e: He is pleased when we are bewildered.
bewilder.c: 我们困惑不解时，他反而很高兴。

anode.e: Tom doesn't understand the difference between a cathode and an anode.
anode.c: 汤姆不明白阴极和阳极的区别。

situated.e: Switzerland is situated between France, Italy, Austria and Germany.
situated.c: 瑞士位于法国、意大利、奥地利和德国之间。

cigaret.e: You have to put out the cigaret.

predestine.e: Today is the day of my predestined meeting.
predestine.c: 今天就是我命中注定的会面之日。

by-product.e: Vegans do not use animal products, or by-products, in their everyday lives.
by-product.c: 纯素食者在日常生活中不使用动物制品，也不使用其副产品。

congest.c: 阿尔及尔的街道越来越堵塞了。

first-rate.e: They looked on the writer as first-rate.
first-rate.c: 他们把那作家看作一流人物。

grants.e: This grants Algeria political leverage in the region.
grants.c: 这使阿尔及利亚在该地区获得了政治影响力。

hypotheses.e: There are several hypotheses to explain this phenomenon.
hypotheses.c: 解释这一现象有几种假说。

second-hand.e: Wearing second-hand clothes is now popular among young people.
second-hand.c: 二手服饰在时下年轻人之间蔚为风潮。

sitting-room.e: She is waiting now in the sitting-room.
sitting-room.c: 她现在正在客厅里等着。
